id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying when fine tuning jobs access is gone

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion: the Mistral AI connector stops retrying 410 responses, preventing repeated requests for unavailable fine-tuning jobs and allowing the warehouse import to proceed or fail cleanly.
review.reason: Adds a 410 Gone error entry to get_non_retryable_errors, treating Mistral 410 as a permanent, non-retryable status. P1.F2.H1: Tests that 410 responses are recognized as non-retryable, and P1.F1.H1: "Fine-tuning is not available for your Mistral AI workspace, so the Fine tuning jobs table can't sync. Disable that table, or check your workspace's fine-tuning access in La Plateforme."
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a specific HTTP status code handling and its corresponding test. While this prevents unnecessary retries and potential rate limiting or resource exhaustion, the exact operational benefit and user impact are not demonstrated by the code alone. No production incident or adoption data is available. The tier is not 3 because the claim
